card.name: Sports rules on limits and permissions
card.fires_on: Words inside sentences that state a sports rule, limit or permitted action, such as 'more than two pushes' or 'any part of their body while in their own area'. Also on 'runs from' in official season dates.

modes.label: Ball-handling rules
modes.description: Words within rules about what players may or may not do with the ball, mostly goalkeeper and wheelchair basketball rules.
modes.example: Unlike other players, goalkeepers may touch the ball with any part<< of>> their body while in their own penalty area

modes.label: Count limits
modes.description: Words in a rule that sets a maximum number, such as more than two pushes.
modes.example: It is a traveling violation to take more<< than>> two pushes on the wheels without a drib

modes.label: Official date spans
modes.description: The word 'from' in an officially stated season range.
modes.example: The hurricane season officially runs<< from>> June 1 through November 30

card.writes: It pushes toward words of official limits and thresholds (officially, exceeding, ineligible) and away from words like early, middle and late.
card.plain: It marks words in rules that say what is allowed or how much is the limit.
